div.div: أَفْلُّ , applied to a sword [or the like], (T, S, O, K,) Having breaks, or notches, in its edge; (T, S, * O; *) or broken, or notched, in its edge; as also ↓ مَفْلُولٌ and ↓ مُنْفَلٌّ . (M, K.) الأَفَلُّ was the name of a sword of 'Adee Ibn-Hátim (O, K) Et- Tá-ee. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
